summary_en: MTI will tender all 5,389,587 shares of Shobunsha Holdings held as an associate company in a tender offer at 752 yen per share, generating proceeds of 4,052 million yen, representing 29.90% of voting rights. Upon completion, MTI will cease to account for Shobunsha as an associate company.
title_en: Notice of Tender Offer Response Agreement for Shares of Associate Company (Shobunsha Holdings Inc.) and Recording of Special Loss (Consolidated) and Special Gain (Non-Consolidated)
translation_en_brief:
MTI entered into a tender offer response agreement on November 6, 2026, to tender all 5,389,587 shares it holds in Shobunsha Holdings (Shobunsha), an associate company, to a tender offer initiated by MSE at 752 yen per share. The total proceeds are 4,052 million yen, representing 29.90% of Shobunsha's voting rights. Following successful completion of the tender offer, Shobunsha will cease to be accounted for as an associate company in MTI's financial statements.

MTI's Board of Directors determined that the tender offer contributes to enhancing Shobunsha's future corporate value and that tendering MTI's entire shareholding has sufficient economic rationality for the company. MSE is a company controlled by Shoji Kuroda, Shobunsha's representative director and its largest shareholder at the time of the offer. The tender offer constitutes a management buyout (MBO) to take Shobunsha private.
